LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Sanctuary.label: divine shelter
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Sanctuary.description: Raise a holy shield around one ally: absorbs 40×P damage, lasting 12 hours. Costs 3 divine favor, cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Banish.label: banish the unholy
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Banish.description: Bring 25×P holy damage down on one enemy (×2 against undead and fiends, another ×1.5 against god-possessed); against the divine-infused, a 30%×P chance to strip their infusion. Costs 4 divine favor, cooldown 6 hours.
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Consecrate.label: hallowed ground
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Consecrate.description: Hallow an area (radius 5) for 1 day: enemy undead and fiends inside take 2×P holy damage per second; lich and troll revival timers pause inside; colonists standing inside get mood +3. Costs 6 divine favor, cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Dawn.label: light of dawn
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Dawn.description: Lathander's domain spell. Allies within 6 cells of the caster stop bleeding and each wound heals 10×P; crops on this land grow +20% for 1 day. Costs 10 divine favor, cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Judgment.label: judgment of truth
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Judgment.description: Tyr's domain spell. Against enemies: deals (10 + humanlike kills/10×5, up to 60)×P divine punishment damage; against colony prisoners: resistance -20×P, will -10×P. Costs 10 divine favor, cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Weave.label: weave surge
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Weave.description: Mystra's domain spell. All of one ally's ability cooldowns are reset, and if they have a psylink, psyfocus +30%. (VPE psycast cooldowns aren't reset here.) Costs 12 divine favor, cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Rest.label: rest eternal
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Rest.description: Kelemvor's domain spell. Enemy undead within 8 cells of the caster take 30×P holy damage; humanlike corpses in range are "laid to rest": their souls can't be drained and they can't be raised. When cast by a lich, the caster takes 20 damage. Costs 8 divine favor, cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Hunt.label: hunting fury
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Hunt.description: Malar's domain spell. Colony animals within 10 cells of the caster get +50%×P melee damage and +20% move speed for 12 hours. Costs 8 divine favor, cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Thunder.label: call lightning
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Thunder.description: Talos's domain spell. Call down 3 lightning strikes on the target area, each dealing 25×P damage, landing randomly up to 2 cells off. Costs 12 divine favor, cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Dread.label: tyrant's command
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Dread.description: Bane's domain spell. Enemies within 6 cells of the caster flee in terror for 10 seconds (mind resistance can resist); giant-bodied and god-possessed are unaffected. Costs 10 divine favor, cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Veil.label: veil of shadow
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_Veil.description: Shar's domain spell. Allies within 5 cells of the caster turn invisible for 20×P seconds; attacking reveals them. Costs 10 divine favor, cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_ForgeWrath.label: fury of the forge
LanguageData.LP_Miracle_ForgeWrath.description: Surtur's domain spell. Breathe a 6-cell cone of molten fire toward the target; enemies inside take 25×P burn damage and catch fire; ×1.25 when cast by a fire giant. Costs 10 divine favor, cooldown 2 days.
